svg.title: Graphic 10.2 — The Avoidance Box
svg.desc: Five-phase obstacle avoidance path and phase handoff diagram. The simple robot icon has been replaced by the approved mini Zumo image with a transparent background. All instructional labels remain live SVG text.
svg.text: TOP-DOWN VIEW — a shape driven from memory, not from sensors
spin right, then step out 15 cm
back to heading, then 20 cm — clears the block
no wheel turns here — see the panel
The plan is not the driving.
The box is a PLAN: out, past,
The hunt belongs to a whole
The robot cannot see any of this.
Once it turns away in phase 1, the block is out of the sensor’s view. It does not check. It does not react. It drives
a shape it memorized before it started — which is why the numbers below have to be right, and why you tune them in §7.
